register.labelZh: HURRY 片語動詞的實際用途
register.summaryZh: hurry up 可以叫人快一點;hurry somebody up 則可以清楚指出被催促的人。；hurry on 可以描述講者、老師或導遊迅速轉到下一條問題、下一頁、下一個話題或活動。；當人群、隊伍、課堂或活動進展得太慢時,可以使用 hurry somebody or something along。；當你希望訂單、維修、送貨或申請更快完成時,可以使用 hurry something up。
register.summaryEn: Hurry up tells someone to move faster. Hurry somebody up shows who is being encouraged to act faster. Hurry on can describe a speaker, teacher or guide moving quickly to the next question, page, topic or activity. Hurry somebody or something along is useful when a group, queue, lesson or activity is progressing too slowly. Hurry something up can be used when you want an order, repair, delivery or application to be completed more quickly.
